text_block_list.text: After a day out, Seiun Sky and I are dozing on the train back when I suddenly awaken.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yawn… Mm… Morning…

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text: Next is the last and final stop—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The last stop… Huh? Where are we?
Having fallen asleep and taken the train to the end of the line, we decide to take a stroll before catching the return train home.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Walking around an unfamiliar place like this feels a little like we're on vacation, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: A vacation wasn't in the plan…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Don't go sweating the details. ♪ Let's just take it easy till the train comes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa whoa, what's that? Could it be…
Spotting something, Seiun Sky turns her back to the sea and takes off running.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This is… I can't believe it! This thing's doing a bang-up job!
I run to catch up and find her passionately admiring a massive rock.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Look at that flat top! It looks sooo comfy. ♪ And with the soothing sound of the waves too, I bet you could catch some fine Zs here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The only trouble would be the light reflecting from the ocean in summer, and then the cold wind in winter… Yeah, points off for those.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay, you get two stars! I think you're worth adding to my "secret nap spots of the country" map.
choice_data_list: You have a secret nap spot map?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Nothing gets past you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's a compilation of the best places to snooze I've found while out and about.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, as long as you've got this map, you can find a great place to zonk right out, wherever you are.
choice_data_list: So basically it's a collection of places you go when you skip practice.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What a scandalous thing to say… Still, can't say you're wrong there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay, back to business. I gave this guy two stars for visuals, but now it's time to assess the sleep situation.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I think a snooze test's in order. See ya when I wake up!
We're going to miss the train if she dozes off here!
We're going to miss the train if she dozes off here!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wow, telling me not to sleep is a lot like telling a gourmand not to eat.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All I'm asking for's about two—no, three hours.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, that bit slipped my mind. We gotta get back to the station soonish, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The harmony between the fluffy seat and the gentle rocking of the carriage… I think someone once called it "the train line lullaby"…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All aboard the three-star nap spot—the train. ♪
It sounds like Sky plans to fall into a deep slumber on the train ride back. That's what got us into this mess in the first place, so I vow to stay awake.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa… You're gonna test it out for me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, it's only natural you'd be curious about how it feels to sleep atop a seaside boulder.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Go ahead then, Trainer. You handle this review.
I decide to give Sky a review that will satisfy her. That way, we can head for the station ASAP.
The sound of the waves is lulling me off to sleep. I can't afford to nod off here, but it's hard to resist…
choice_data_list: Oh no… At this rate… I'll actually…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, good morning. I mean, it's already dark out, so I guess it's good evening.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You looked reeeal comfy. ♪ Yep, my nap spot radar's as reliable as ever.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: While you were out cold I even went and found some other spots that looked ripe for napping.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Fancy testing those out too?
Sky still looks eager to explore, but I manage to persuade her that we should make for the station.
